description: Expected identity/version outcomes for protocol v1 lifecycle operations.

scenarios.name: register_original_image
scenarios.input: A user explicitly registers previously untracked image bytes.

scenarios.name: register_original_video
scenarios.input: A user explicitly registers previously untracked video bytes.

scenarios.name: copy_move_rename_transfer
scenarios.input: The exact same bytes are copied, moved, renamed, or sent to another person.

scenarios.name: human_edit_continuation
scenarios.input: A person changes bytes and continues the same asset lineage.

scenarios.name: ai_modification_claim
scenarios.input: An application declares an AI modification and output bytes differ.

scenarios.name: format_conversion
scenarios.input: A file is re-encoded and output bytes differ while continuing the asset.

scenarios.name: independent_branches
scenarios.input: Two actors independently edit the same parent version.

scenarios.name: separate_derivative
scenarios.input: A creator makes a derivative treated as a separate asset.

scenarios.name: composition_from_multiple_sources
scenarios.input: A new asset combines two or more registered source versions.

scenarios.name: duplicate_bytes_new_registration
scenarios.input: A different publisher explicitly registers byte-identical content as a distinct asset.

scenarios.name: changed_file_claims_known_version
scenarios.input: A verifier receives bytes whose hash differs from a specifically claimed committed Version.

scenarios.name: unknown_file
scenarios.input: No matching trusted Origin/Version record is found.
